title: 8415--Safety Shoes  Base Plus 4
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.246-NETWORK CONTRACTING OFFICE 6 (36C246)
detail_text: This is a Pre-solicitation notice. This Pre-solicitation notice is not a request for formal proposals or quotes. Solicitation, 36C24626Q528, will be issued on or about May 4, 2026. The Department of Veterans Affairs has a requirement for Safety Shoes for the Salisbury VA Medical Center, Salisbury, North Carolina. This acquisition is set aside 100% for Small Businesses. The applicable NAICS Code is 316210 with a size standard of 1000 employees. All correspondence and responses shall be via e-mail to kenya.robinson@va.gov . Telephone requests for information or questions will NOT be accepted. Offerors are responsible for downloading all documents including amendments from Contracting Opportunities at sam.gov website without further notification from the Contracting Officer.
